packs.title: Streets, Parks and City Views
packs.promise: Explore Phuket City at street, park and hillside scales.

q.s: Collect three contrasts at Wat Wichit Sangkharam.
st: From the permitted outdoor approach, find a building edge that runs across the slope and another that rises against it.
Collect three observations: a change in height, a contrast between building and planting, and a line that guides your eye.
Write how those three details make this place feel different from a flat street.

q.s: Connect fresh and dry goods at Municipal Market 1.
st: Walk an open customer aisle without interrupting trading.
Choose three visible goods: one fresh plant ingredient, one dry or preserved item, and a third that you could imagine using with either.
Write a possible meal connection, separating what you actually saw from your own imagined recipe.

q.s: Walk a short loop at King Rama IX Park.
st: Choose an open dry public walking path within King Rama IX Park, with room to share the path and stop safely.
Walk at an easy pace for about ten minutes, noticing a change in shade, a pond view and a sound. Turn back sooner if needed.
At a safe stopping point, write how the path’s rhythm changed between those three observations.

packs.title: Two Old Town Afternoons
packs.promise: Follow Phuket Old Town through houses, displays and street details.

q.t: A House Open to the Sky
q.s: Collect three domestic details at Chinpracha House.
st: Enter through the ordinary visitor entrance and follow the host’s permitted route.
Collect three visible details: the open-air courtyard or pond, a floor or window detail, and one household object.
Write how one architectural detail and the object suggest different needs of a home. Treat your interpretation as your own.

q.s: Create a short object scene after Moh Seng’s museum visit.
st: Pay or present the entry required for an ordinary museum visit and follow its actual admitted route.
Choose one historical household or everyday object that is actually displayed. Remember its shape and an observed display detail.
After leaving, write or draw a two-part scene: the object as you saw it, then an imagined moment of everyday use. Label the second part as your own imagination and connect it to the observed shape.

q.s: Create a small rhythm on Soi Rommani.
st: Find two visible facade details that repeat a colour or line along the public alley.
Move out of doorways and the walking line before making your work.
Create a three-beat written phrase or simple pattern: repeat the first observed detail twice and let the second change the third beat. Add a note naming the actual details.
